recommended_fix.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Primary Provision Rule 6(1)(a) has Penalty Ceiling ₹250 crore (maximum under the Schedule; actual amount set by the Board under s.33).

recommended_fix.guidance: Hold the Aadhaar number only in an encrypted vault or behind a reference token, and keep it out of application tables, logs, caches and files. Keep every collection, storage and sharing path within the limits of Aadhaar Act 2016 §29 and the Aadhaar (Sharing of Information) Regulations 2016.

recommended_fix.guidance: Protect each Tier A and Tier B Personal Data Element at field or column level before it is stored, with keys held outside the data store, so that a database dump or a restored backup does not reveal the values. Disk or volume encryption protects only the storage medium, so it lowers severity without clearing the Finding. Until DPDP §44(2) omits IT Act §43A, that section's reasonable-security duty applies alongside Rule 6(1)(a).
